# DenFlow Plumbing & Water Solutions

> DenFlow Plumbing & Water Solutions is a Nairobi-based plumbing company run by Dennis Mwangi, offering pipe installation, plumbing repairs, drain unblocking, bio digester installation and house pointing. We serve Nairobi and its environs, with 24/7 emergency call-outs.

DenFlow has 4 years of hands-on plumbing experience and has completed 20+ projects for homes, apartments, rentals, shops and small commercial buildings. We assess each job, agree the scope and price before work begins, and leave the site clean.

- Website: https://denflow.co.ke

## Services

- **Piping & Pipe Installation** — New water lines, replacements and re-piping for homes, flats and commercial buildings. https://denflow.co.ke/#piping-and-pipe-installation
- **Plumbing Repairs** — Fast fixes for leaks, burst pipes, faulty taps, toilets and showers, with emergency call-outs. https://denflow.co.ke/#plumbing-repairs
- **Drain Unblocking** — Clearing blocked sinks, toilets and drains, and restoring proper flow. https://denflow.co.ke/#drain-unblocking
- **Bio Digester Installation** — Modern, odour-free wastewater treatment for homes and estates without a sewer connection. https://denflow.co.ke/#bio-digester-installation
- **House Pointing** — Neat, durable pointing that protects walls from water damage and improves appearance. https://denflow.co.ke/#house-pointing
- **Water Tanks & Pumps** — Tank installation, booster pumps and pressure systems for reliable water supply. https://denflow.co.ke/#water-tanks-and-pumps
- **Leak Detection & Repair** — Finding hidden leaks before they damage walls, floors and your water bill. https://denflow.co.ke/#leak-detection-and-repair
- **Water Heaters & Solar** — Installation and repair of electric water heaters and solar water heating systems. https://denflow.co.ke/#water-heaters-and-solar
- **Bathroom & Kitchen Fit-outs** — Complete plumbing for bathroom and kitchen upgrades, from pipework to fittings. https://denflow.co.ke/#bathroom-and-kitchen-fitouts

## How pricing works

Plumbing costs depend on the scope of the job, materials required and how accessible the pipework is. DenFlow does not use a fixed call-out price list. We assess the problem, explain the work and agree a quote with you before starting. Quotes are free for planned work; emergency call-outs are confirmed when you call.

## Frequently asked questions

**How much does a plumber cost in Nairobi?**
Costs depend on the scope of the job, materials and access to the pipework. DenFlow assesses the problem, explains the work and agrees a quote before starting. Call or WhatsApp +254 719 397 182 for a free quote.

**Do you offer emergency plumbing in Nairobi?**
Yes. DenFlow offers 24-hour emergency call-outs across Nairobi and its environs for burst pipes, major leaks, blocked drains and other urgent problems. Call +254 719 397 182.

**How do you unblock a blocked drain?**
We locate the blockage, then use drain rods, plunging or line-clearing equipment to remove it. We flush the line afterwards and check water drains freely. If the blockage returns, we investigate causes such as grease, roots or a damaged pipe.

**What is a bio digester and how does installation work?**
A bio digester treats household wastewater on site using bacteria, producing safer effluent and less sludge than a basic septic tank. Installation starts with a site assessment covering plot size, soil and household water use.

**What areas of Nairobi do you serve?**
Nairobi and its environs, including the areas listed above. If your area is not listed, call to check whether we can help.

**Do you give quotes before starting work?**
Yes. We agree the scope and price with you before work begins, and discuss anything unexpected before continuing.

**How do I book a plumber?**
Call or WhatsApp +254 719 397 182, or use the quote form at https://denflow.co.ke/#contact with your name, phone number, service and estate.
